value.rationale: The exact signed social contagion model was motivated by observed counterintuitive connectivity suppression. The new complete phase-shape restriction shows such suppression is confined to a single connected distrust window for every admissible rate tuple; the threshold specifies when the window exists and the square-root law quantifies how it emerges. Exact two-crossing realizations demonstrate substantive new possibilities not captured by a single plotted crossing. This controls a natural sensitivity question without computing equilibria for each candidate degree. Interpretation is explicitly limited to homogeneous deterministic mean-field equilibria.
